title: Man believed to be top Bishnoi Gang lieutenant wanted in 2023 Winnipeg killing
summary: A man with connections to the international Bishnoi Gang is now wanted in the 2023 killing of a Winnipeg man, police say.

image.caption: Winnipeg police say Satinderjeet Singh, also known as Goldy Brar, is wanted in the 2023 murder of Sukhdool Singh Gill. (FBI)

blocks.text: A man with connections to the international Bishnoi Gang is now wanted in the 2023 killing of a Winnipeg man, police say.
Satinderjeet Singh, 32, also known as Goldy Brar, wanted in death of Sukhdool Singh Gill: Winnipeg police
A man believed to be a former top lieutenant in the international Bishnoi Gang is now wanted in the 2023 killing of a Winnipeg man, police say.
Winnipeg police are now among several police forces looking for Satinderjeet Singh, 32, commonly known by the name Goldy Brar.
He is wanted in Winnipeg on charges of first-degree murder and conspiracy to commit murder, Winnipeg police said in a news release.
On Sept. 20, 2023, police were called to a home on Hazelton Drive in northwest Winnipeg with reports of a shooting. At the scene, they found the body of Sukhdool Singh Gill, 39.
At the time, CBC reported that Gill was accused of extortion and sending money to gang associates in India and had been embroiled in a longstanding feud with rival gangs there.

blocks.text: Singh’s current location is unknown, but investigators believe he still in Canada, Winnipeg police said. He is believed to frequent the Montreal and Brampton, Ont., areas.

In July, Singh was among those indicted in a United States operation for his involvement in the Lawrence Bishnoi gang, a South Asian organized crime group that has been declared a terrorist organization by the Canadian government.
The FBI has offered a $1 million reward for information leading to his arrest.

Singh is now at the top of the 25 most wanted in the Winnipeg Police Service's Bolo program — an acronym for "be on the lookout." Winnipeg police are offering a $250,000 reward for information leading to his arrest in Canada or the U.S.
He is also wanted in India for murder, according to the Bolo program, which runs awareness campaigns about fugitives with Canadian police forces.
Karanbir Singh has been charged with first-degree murder and conspiracy to commit murder in connection with the 2023 Winnipeg killing. (Submitted by Winnipeg Police Service)
Winnipeg police are also searching for Karanbir Singh, 26, in connection with Gill's killing. Karanbir Singh has also been charged with first-degree murder and conspiracy to commit murder.
Both men are considered armed and dangerous, police said. The public shouldn't approach them if they are spotted.
Anyone with information about their location can contact investigators at 431-334-9160, Winnipeg police said.
